description: Named OpenStreetMap features tagged amenity=events_venue in the Netherlands, derived from the EU-POIS/NL quadkey-tiled POI export (zoom 12). The source ships only name and coordinates - no administrative attribute - so no province or gemeente split is possible without inference, and none was made. Native Dutch names preserved (ensure_ascii=False).
